themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously within research workflows, including data gathering and analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to assist developers with writing, debugging, and reviewing code, often with security implications.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of artificial users or data to simulate real user behavior for testing and research.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to automate, augment, or analyze the process of testing product usability.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting notes or research findings, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing various AI-powered tools specifically designed to support and accelerate different aspects of the research process.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly aid designers and researchers in their creative and analytical tasks.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles about using AI to analyze and understand user sentiment from text-based feedback sources.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications used for market research, competitive analysis, and understanding product performance.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores how AI is leveraged to extract meaningful insights from customer data and interactions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
